description: Heatmap by Powerviz provides a powerful way to visualize data density or value distribution across categories or dimensions using color gradients. It condenses complex datasets into an easy-to-interpret matrix format, where each cell's color intensity reflects the data's magnitude or frequency. The Heatmap is ideal for identifying patterns, correlations, and outliers within large datasets, making it indispensable for data-driven decision-making. Check out the live demo here. To access all the advanced settings, click the gear "⚙️" icon in the top-right corner. Key Feature Highlights: Shapes: Select from various built-in shapes, including Default, Fixed, and Diverging varieties. Data Colors: Offers 30+ color palettes including color-blind safe mode with the flexibility to add colors by data classes or by using a custom color field. Data Labels: Choose from 3 display styles or add custom data labels with formatting options to customize the labels. Axis Settings: Customize the axes by adding position and text formatting. Grid Lines: Enhance the visual structure and readability of your data using grid lines. Plot Area: Customize the plot area by choosing the maximum number of rows or columns to display.
